content:
The image shows a mango leaf with necrotic, brown lesions concentrated at the **tip and upper margin** of the leaf. The affected tissue is dry and tan/brown with irregular margins, and there is some browning extending inward from the tip. The rest of the leaf is mostly green with slight yellowing near the lesion.

Key observations:
- Tip dieback with brown, desiccated necrosis
- No white powdery coating (rules out Powdery Mildew)
- No black sooty coating (rules out Sooty Mould)
- No water-soaked or sunken spots typical of Anthracnose
- Classic progression of browning from the shoot tip downward — consistent with Die Back
